diagnostics.message: google_alloydb_user.users has no dependency on google_alloydb_instance.primary; its only ordering dependency is the primary cluster (cluster = google_alloydb_cluster.primary.id). AlloyDB only allows database users/roles to be created once the cluster has a primary instance — the provider's documented examples for both ALLOYDB_BUILT_IN and ALLOYDB_IAM_USER users explicitly add `depends_on = [google_alloydb_instance.<primary>]`. Without it, applying a fresh project can race: Terraform may attempt users.create while the primary instance is still provisioning, and the API call fails. Add `depends_on = [google_alloydb_instance.primary]` to google_alloydb_user.users.
